orgs.nameFr: Les Services de bien-être et moral des Forces canadiennes (SBMFC)

domains.descEn: A sense of purpose in life is important to well-being. Transitioning members can feel lost or disoriented because they now need to replace the purpose they had in the military with something new.
domains.descFr: Le sentiment d’avoir un but précis dans la vie est important pour le bien-être. Les militaires en cours de transition vers la vie civile peuvent se sentir perdus ou désorientés, car ils doivent maintenant remplacer le but qu’ils avaient dans les Forces par quelque chose de nouveau.

domains.descEn: Sufficient finances are associated with independence, healthy lifestyle choices, access to health services, quality of housing, family stability, and avoidance of debt.
domains.descFr: Des ressources financières suffisantes vont de pair avec une multitude de situations positives : l’indépendance, un mode de vie sain, l’accès aux services de santé, un bon logement, la stabilité familiale et l’évitement de l’endettement.

domains.descEn: Health can be viewed as the physical, social, mental, and spiritual ability of an individual to function well.
domains.descFr: On peut définir la santé comme étant la capacité physique, sociale, mentale et spirituelle d’une personne à bien fonctionner.

domains.descEn: The life skills domain refers to the knowledge, insights and experiences that prepare military members to adapt to civilian life.
domains.descFr: Le domaine des aptitudes à la vie quotidienne se rapporte aux compétences, aux connaissances et aux expériences personnelles qui préparent les militaires à s’adapter à la vie civile.

domains.descEn: Building new civilian social networks is important to find all the resources and supports available to you as you adjust to civilian life, and to reshape your military identity into a civilian one.
domains.descFr: L’établissement de réseaux sociaux civils est essentiel pour trouver les ressources et les mesures de soutien à votre disposition pendant que vous vous ajustez à la vie civile et que vous refaçonnez votre identité militaire en identité civile.

domains.descEn: Finding a nice home to live in is only part of the story.  It's important to ensure that the physical environment you inhabit will meet your emotional needs as well.
domains.descFr: Trouver un bon logement où vivre n’est qu’un élément de l’histoire. Il importe de s’assurer que votre environnement physique répond aussi à vos besoins émotionnels.

domains.descEn: Focuses on how transitioning members and Veterans are perceived and accepted by civilian society, how they are understood, valued and supported by the community.
domains.descFr: Est axé sur la manière dont les militaires en transition et les vétérans sont perçus et acceptés par la société civile, comment ils sont compris, valorisés et soutenus par la communauté.

orgs.briefDescEn: Supporting the CAF community through fitness, recreation and leisure activities, family support, retail and personal financial services.
orgs.detailedDescEn: CFMWS is dedicated to Canadian Armed Forces members, Veterans and their families through the provision of fitness, recreation and leisure activities, family support, retail and personal financial services. Our programs and services contribute to operational readiness by making our members stronger mentally, socially, physically and financially at the individual and community level.
orgs.briefDescFr: Appui à la communauté des FAC : conditionnement physique, loisirs, soutien aux familles, services financiers et vente au détail.
orgs.detailedDescFr: Les SBMFC, dévoués aux membres et aux vétérans des FAC et à leurs familles, offrent des programmes de conditionnement physique et de loisirs, du soutien aux familles, ainsi que des services financiers personnels et des services de vente au détail. Ces programmes et services contribuent à l’état de préparation opérationnelle en rendant les membres des FAC plus forts, individuellement et collectivement, sur les plans mental, social, physique et financier.

orgs.briefDescEn: 1000 Islands Addiction Treatment Centre delivers structured inpatient addiction treatment grounded in evidence‑based care.
orgs.detailedDescEn: 1000 Islands takes a person‑centred approach to treatment, placing each client’s strengths, needs, goals, and preferences at the core of care. Treatment emphasizes abstinence, recovery capital, and integration of community supports into discharge planning. Family members may join a six‑week virtual Family Support Program, and clients are encouraged to participate in six months of tailored virtual aftercare. Treatment is trauma‑informed and grounded in CBT, DBT, and Motivational Interviewing.

orgs.briefDescEn: We are a network of veteran owned, veteran/reserve and family friendly Managed Service Providers in the IT & Cybersecurity compliance across Canada.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
123 Cyber exists to make our customers more competent in managing cyber risk. We take the heaviest load of supervision for governance, risk assessment and compliance off the plate for senior leaders who have zero bandwidth or knowledge in cyber security.
And we do this by employing veterans and promoting veteran owned businesses. We do not sell software or compete with Managed Service Providers. We work with them, to help grow their cyber businesses and create great career opportunities.

orgs.briefDescEn: As a veteran, I specialize in providing kinesiology services to veterans, focusing on understanding the multifaceted nature of military injuries.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
At 613 Fitness, we are proud to offer group classes, personal training, kids/teens classes, team conditioning, and clinical kinesiology services, emphasizing a holistic approach to health that encompasses physical, social, and emotional well-being.

Clinical kinesiology focuses on the science of human movement, applying evidence-based research to improve function, health, and wellness. Our services aim to treat injury, with a specific ability to help veterans, because I am a 38-year veteran.

orgs.briefDescEn: Fully regulated Ontario Career College which has been in operation since 1990 providing relevant training in a relaxed adult learning environment.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
We are an accredited, fully regulated Ontario Career College which offers a variety of programs to meet the needs of the continually changing labour market.

With the understanding that each student learns in a unique way, we offer one-on-one support, customized training plans, and provide the flexibility to students to help them balance education with personal  responsibilities.  

Programs include Business Administration, Information Technology, Healthcare, Web/Graphic Design, and more.

orgs.detailedDescEn: ADGA Group is a Canadian-owned defence and security company that has supported Canada’s defence, security and public safety missions for nearly 60 years. orgs.briefDescEn: Your Veteran Ottawa Realtor.
orgs.detailedDescEn: After 22 years serving in the CAF from coast to coast and in between, I settled in Ottawa and transitioned to a 2nd career in Real Estate. orgs.briefDescEn: The Benefits Delivery Modernization Programme (BDM) is a department-wide transformation that is modernizing Benefits delivery to Canadians.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
The Benefits Delivery Modernization Programme (BDM) is a department-wide transformation that will improve the client and employee experience regarding benefits delivery. By 2030, the Programme will bring together on one common delivery platform:
Old Age Security (OAS)
Employment Insurance (EI)
the Canada Pension Plan (CPP)
orgs.briefDescFr: Le Programme de modernisation du versement des prestations (MVP) est une transformation à l'échelle du Ministère qui modernise la prestation des prest
orgs.detailedDescFr:
Le Programme de modernisation de la prestation des avantages sociaux (MVP) est une transformation à l'échelle du ministère qui améliorera l'expérience des clients et des employés en matière de prestation des avantages sociaux. D’ici 2030, le Programme rassemblera sur une plateforme de prestation commune :
Sécurité de la vieillesse (SV)
Assurance-emploi (AE)
le Régime de pensions du Canada (RPC)

orgs.briefDescEn: We provide assitance with completing the Disability Tax Credit and can link applicants with health practitioners to review and sign the application.
orgs.detailedDescEn: The Benefits2 website guides applicants through the Disability Tax Credit application, providing the applicant with the proper wording to describe impairments to improve the odds of a successful application.  The site creates an application ready for healthcare provider signature to submit to CRA.  We also provide guided applications for persons unfamiliar with the credit and form, and we can connect applicants to a healthcare provider to review their records and sign the form.

orgs.briefDescEn: I work with individuals to assist them with their transition into retirement with a focus on the non-financial (lifestyle) aspects of this life phase.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
My work with clients transitioning into retirement revolves around 4 key spheres:

-Purpose and meaning in retirement
-Functional fitness and physical wellness
-Mental well-being and lifelong learning
-Social engagement and community connections

I work with clients to facilitate the creation of a retirement lifestyle plan, easing their transition into this life phase by creating a structure (framework) for them to explore key questions and ideas in the above 4 categories.

domains.descEn: A sense of purpose in life is important to well-being. Transitioning members can feel lost or disoriented because they now need to replace the purpose they had in the military with something new.

orgs.briefDescEn: Calian Group delivers innovative solutions that help the world communicate, learn, lead healthy lives and stay safe.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Calian Group Ltd. is a diversified Canadian company offering professional services in health, IT, training, engineering, and manufacturing. They provide these services to numerous industries, including the health, defence, security, aerospace, and infrastructure markets.
orgs.briefDescFr: Le Groupe Calian propose des solutions novatrices qui aident le monde à communiquer, à apprendre, à mener une vie saine et à rester en sécurité.
orgs.detailedDescFr: Le Groupe Calian Ltd. est une entreprise canadienne diversifiée offrant des services professionnels en santé, en TI, en formation, en ingénierie et en fabrication. orgs.briefDescEn: The mission of the Canadian Veteran Service Dog Unit is to provide trained service dogs to military veterans and first responders suffering from PTSD
orgs.detailedDescEn: The CVSDU is a veteran-run registered charity that provides service dogs to individuals diagnosed with PTSD.  We have a highly trained core of dog trainers and a clinical psychologist as part of our Team that help train members how to work with their dog and successfully re-integrate back into public life, and back to a healthy relationship with their family and friends. We currently service the Ottawa Area, the Greater Toronto Area and Petawawa but we have plans to expand nationally.

orgs.briefDescEn: CERIC is a charitable organization that advances education and research in career counselling and development in Canada.
orgs.detailedDescEn: CERIC is a charitable organization that advances education and research in career counselling and development to increase the economic and social well-being of people in Canada. It funds projects to develop innovative resources that build the knowledge and skills of diverse career professionals. CERIC also annually hosts Cannexus, Canada’s largest bilingual career development conference, publishes the Canadian Journal of Career Development, and runs the CareerWise / OrientAction websites.
orgs.briefDescFr: Le CERIC est un organisme caritatif voué à la progression de l’éducation et de la recherche en développement de carrière.

L’organisme finance des projets axés sur la mise au point de ressources novatrices permettant aux spécialistes de l’orientation d’enrichir leurs compétences. Le CERIC organise en outre Cannexus, le plus grand congrès bilingue en développement de carrière au Canada, publie la Revue canadienne de développement de carrière, et gère les sites Web CareerWise / OrientAction.

orgs.detailedDescEn: While chronic pain cannot be treated, it can be managed. The CPCoE works as a research centre to improve the understanding of Veteran-specific chronic pain and how best to manage it. orgs.briefDescEn: EHN Guardians offers evidence‑based, trauma‑informed mental health and addiction treatment for military members and veterans across Canada.
orgs.detailedDescEn: EHN Guardians is a specialized program that supports the mental health and recovery of military members and veterans. Care is delivered by experienced teams who understand military life and culture.

orgs.briefDescEn: Foresight Sports Canada is proud to honour our heroes. Through Operation Forevets, our goal is to assist you in your recovery.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Foresight Sports Canada is honoured and committed to working with the Canadian Armed Forces. Since we launched Operation ForeVets, our products have been assisting the military and veterans. Foresight Sports Canada’s simulators are easily installed in the customers home, should they have mobility issues.  Our team is dedicated to helping others improve their golf game, as well as their mental health by encouraging our veterans to engage in the golf community, especially with family and friends.
orgs.briefDescFr: Foresight Sports Canada est fier d’aider ses héros. L’Opération Forevets est conçue pour vous aider à récupérer.
orgs.detailedDescFr: Foresight Sports Canada est honoré de travailler avec les Forces armées canadiennes et s'est engagé à le faire. Depuis l'opération ForeVets, nos produits aident les vétérans. Les simulateurs de Foresight Sports Canada peuvent facilement être installés à la maison des clients s'ils ont des problèmes de mobilité. Notre équipe s'engage à aider les autres à améliorer leur jeu de golf et leur santé mentale en persuadant nos vétérans de participer à la communauté du golf, avec leurs proches.

orgs.briefDescEn: We provide frameworks and strategies to launch businesses that mitigate risk and uncertainty.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
Founder Led Consulting is a consulting firm started by Justin Urquhart, a former CAF member, and Harry Koundakjian. 

Founder Led Consulting is a consulting firm dedicated to professionals who have amazing products or services, but are not sure of the complexities of business. 

We have launched and assisted businesses/corporations primarily in the health domain, but are industry agnostic.

We also provide assistance to local innovation hubs, including Carleton University.

orgs.briefDescEn: Fredericton Homeless Shelters Inc. (The Shelters) provide shelter and services for marginalized people in Western NB.
orgs.detailedDescEn: The Shelters provide a host of programs and spaces for those who are homeless or who are one pay cheque away from homeless. We have a number of Veteran specific programs from Prevention and Diversion to Shelters to transitional housing to a dedicated Veteran Community Navigator. We hold two contracts for Vets, one with VAC and one with Housing Infrastructure Communities Canada. We have one and usually two apartments that Vet may be able to access.

orgs.briefDescEn: After decades of collecting, this site's curator Paul Gillmore (ACS 565 Sgt retired) proudly wants to share. Please enjoy viewing his collections.
orgs.detailedDescEn: I hope you enjoy looking through my selection of items. Most were collected to preserve the past. As a temporary owner of these items, it's my responsibility to now move them into the future. Over the next several months and years, I'll be opening up more boxes and continually adding, so please do check back regularly. If you see something you'd like to enjoy, let me know and it'll be on-its-way shortly to you, carefully packaged and sent with all the best wishes this life has to offer.

orgs.briefDescEn: We are a blacksmith studio that teaches basic blacksmithing.
orgs.detailedDescEn: At Got Your 6 Ironworks our mission is to provide a safe and supportive environment for individuals coping with PTSD and anxiety to find healing and empowerment through the art of blacksmithing and bladesmithing. We believe in the transformative power of craftsmanship, and we are committed to offering a space where individuals can explore their creativity, develop new skills, and forge meaningful connections with others on similar journeys.

K9s4PTSD was founded by Rick de Gruvl. A Veteran of the Canadian Forces, Military Police and volunteer Firefighter.
K9s4PTSD

-ways to discover and express creativity 
-the practice of forging requires mindfulness, presence in the moment and grounding.

orgs.briefDescEn: Interdisciplinary clinic specializing in chronic pain care for veterans, offering coordinated medical, mental health, and rehab service.
orgs.detailedDescEn: One to One Wellness is an interdisciplinary clinic in Halifax focused on chronic pain care for veterans. Our team includes a physician, nurse practitioner, physiotherapists, psychologists, occupational therapists, and sleep medicine specialists delivering coordinated, evidence-based care. orgs.briefDescEn: Prospect is an innovative NFP organization that has been assisting Albertans to find meaningful work since our establishment in 1987.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
Our mission is to reduce barriers and deliver sustainable solutions so that everyone, regardless of circumstance, can reach their employment potential. Our goal is to build a productive workforce; one that is skilled, diverse, and inclusive. 

Prospect has been offering our Forces@WORK program since 2010. Historically, the project helped ill and injured members of the CAF and Veterans transition into civilian employment. The program operates throughout the province of Alberta.

orgs.briefDescEn: Pure Movement is multidisciplinary team providing physiotherapy, aquatic rehab, pilates physiotherapy and massage therapy.
orgs.detailedDescEn: At Pure Movement, we are proud to support recently retired members of the Canadian Armed Forces as they transition to civilian life. Our multidisciplinary team offers personalized, evidence-based rehabilitation designed to address the unique physical challenges faced by veterans.

orgs.detailedDescEn: Our Association is a network of former RCMP employees who are dedicated to retaining our strong ties forged in the Force, investing in each other to maintain and expand a coordinated network of mutual support for today, tomorrow, and always. This aligns with our Mission “To be responsive to the physical, psychological, social and economic welfare of all former employees of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police and their families.”

We’re here for you through all life stages— whether it’s special needs care for children, recovery from surgery, respite care, ongoing support to enjoy what you love or compassionate palliative care. orgs.briefDescEn: At Roland Gossage Foundation, we support veterans' civilian transition via Soldiers in Tech & Soldiers in the Arts.
orgs.detailedDescEn: At the Roland Gossage Foundation, our primary focus is on improving the lives of military personnel and their families as they transition to civilian life. We are dedicated to addressing the challenges that veterans face when leaving the military and entering the civilian world. Our two unique programs, Soldiers in Tech and Soldiers in the Arts, are designed to provide veterans with opportunities to pursue new careers.
orgs.briefDescFr: À la Fondation Roland Gossage, nous soutenons la transition civile des anciens combattants via Soldiers in Tech & Soldiers in the Arts.
orgs.detailedDescFr: À la Fondation Roland Gossage, notre objectif principal est d'améliorer la vie des militaires et de leurs familles lors de leur transition vers la vie civile. Nous nous engageons à relever les défis auxquels sont confrontés les anciens combattants lorsqu’ils quittent l’armée et entrent dans le monde civil. Nos deux programmes uniques, Soldiers in Tech et Soldiers in the Arts, sont conçus pour offrir aux anciens combattants la possibilité de poursuivre de nouvelles carrières.

orgs.briefDescEn: Rotman is UofT’s graduate business school, offering transformative learning.
orgs.detailedDescEn: The Rotman School of Management is a catalyst for transformative learning, research, and public engagement. They bring together diverse views and initiatives around a defining purpose – to create value for business and society.

orgs.briefDescEn: Transportation and Logistics company serving North America
orgs.detailedDescEn:
RY XPRESS TRANSPORTATION 
Based in Hamilton, Ontario, RY Xpress Transportation and Logistics offers comprehensive trucking and logistics services across North America, including Mexico. We specialize in flatbed trucking, cross-border transportation, warehousing, and distribution. Our dedicated customer service, commitment to sustainability, and expertise in time-sensitive deliveries and specialized services ensure your freight is delivered safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

orgs.briefDescEn: Saint Mary’s University is a vibrant top-ranked university nestled in the heart of downtown Halifax.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Saint Mary’s is one of Canada’s top primarily undergraduate universities. Home to a diverse group of 6,500 students, we are known for collaborations, entrepreneurship, and research. Founded in 1802, Saint Mary’s is the second largest university in the province, with programs in Arts, Science, Business, and Graduate Studies and Research. Students have access to world-class opportunities and great student-faculty relationships. We work with and for our community to create a world without limits.
orgs.briefDescFr: L'Université Saint Mary's est une université dynamique de premier plan nichée au cœur du centre-ville d'Halifax.
orgs.detailedDescFr: Saint Mary’s est l’une des meilleures universités de premier cycle au Canada. Abritant un groupe diversifié de 6 500 étudiants, nous sommes connus pour nos collaborations, notre entrepreneuriat et notre recherche. Fondée en 1802, Saint Mary's est la deuxième plus grande université de la province, avec des programmes en arts, sciences, commerce ainsi qu'études supérieures et recherche.

orgs.briefDescEn: SAJE Wrap & Window Films provides architectural wrap for refreshing spaces, and glass films for solar reduction, privacy, security and branding.
orgs.detailedDescEn: SAJE Wrap & Window Films is an architectural wrap and window film installer, dealer and design consultant for interior and exterior residential and commercial spaces. Wrapping includes furniture, cabinets, doors, floors, walls in both interior and exterior environments. SAJE provides the similar offerings for windows: solar (IR/UV reduction), security (break resistant), privacy, branding, and smart film (switchable privacy and solar film) products.

orgs.briefDescEn: Sarah Carr Psychological Services is a private psychology practice. We provide counselling, assessments, consultations, and more.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Sarah Carr Psychological Services (CarrPsych) is a private psychology practice in Charlottetown, PE. We are a team of Registered Psychologists, Counselling Therapists and graduate student interns who aim to provide evidence-based, effective clinical care for our clients. Our clinicians are passionate, engaged, growth-oriented, non-judgmental, and professional. We use evidenced-based, current, best practice approaches including CBT, DBT, PE, and more to address PTSD, depression, anxiety, etc.

orgs.briefDescEn: The Seafarers’ International Union of Canada has been serving unlicensed seafarers since 1938. The SIU represents the majority of sailors in Canada
orgs.detailedDescEn:
The Seafarers’ International Union of Canada has been serving unlicensed seafarers since 1938. Better known as the SIU, we represent the majority of unlicensed sailors working aboard vessels on the Great Lakes, the St. Lawrence River, on the East and the West Coasts, and in the Arctic. In addition to vessels operated in Canadian waters, SIU members also have the opportunity to work aboard vessels delivering cargoes internationally.
We are thousands of members strong and growing.

orgs.briefDescEn: South-East Ottawa Community Health Centre is a non-profit, community-governed organization that provides comprehensive healthcare services.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Our services include: primary care, health promotion, social services, community & resource development, home support & advocacy. orgs.briefDescEn: Spark Employment Services provides free services to jobseekers to help them enhance their employability & secure a job.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Spark Employment Services is a non-profit Employment Ontario organization that aims to bridge the gap between employers and jobseekers and provide employment and education services to the citizens of Greater Sudbury in order to help them enhance their employability and secure a job. orgs.briefDescEn: Unlock a better work-life: we will help you explore your status quo, discover your strengths, and identify actions to achieve excellence.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
When transitioning to civilian life, you need a clear plan to visualize and execute your approach. We will help with:
- transferring your skills and competencies,
- exploring your next steps,
- setting clear career goals,
- advocating and selling yourself positively,
- deciding between starting a business or finding the ideal job,
- pivoting your career into a civilian role,
- understanding your strengths, and
- achieving success, happiness, and peace of mind.

orgs.briefDescFr: Tech Vets Canada est un organisme de bienfaisance dédié au soutien des anciens combattants.
orgs.detailedDescFr: Tech Vets Canada se consacre à soutenir les anciens combattants dans leur parcours de reconversion et de perfectionnement vers des emplois liés à la cybersécurité. orgs.briefDescEn: Valor Wellness is a veteran owned and operated wellness center.  We focus on holistic evidence based treatment options.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
I am Mark Morrison, a combat veteran and the founder of Valor Wellness. I would like to clarify some important points about our organization.
We are a veterans wellness center. We are not a medical cannabis provider, nor do we buy, sell, or distribute cannabis. Our holistic services, such as massage are offered as a direct billing option to veterans.  We offer free help with VAC paperwork, claims and exit paperwork and many community lead programs and services.
*contact me to discuss further.

orgs.briefDescEn: Wheels for the Wise provides trauma-informed medical transportation and companionship, prioritizing Veterans, seniors, and adults in Canada.
orgs.detailedDescEn: We are proud to be Canada’s first dedicated Trauma-Informed Mobility Service for Veterans and other medically eligible individuals. This is not standard non-emergency transportation. This is professional, dignity-first mobility support designed specifically for those living with pensioned physical injuries, chronic pain, PTSD, cognitive challenges, and mobility impairments. We pick up clients, assist them to their appointment, remain available throughout, and ensure they return home safely.

domains.descEn: Building new civilian social networks is important to find all the resources and supports available to you as you adjust to civilian life, and to reshape your military identity into a civilian one.
domains.descFr: L’établissement de réseaux sociaux civils est essentiel pour trouver les ressources et les mesures de soutien à votre disposition pendant que vous vous ajustez à la vie civile et que vous refaçonnez votre identité militaire en identité civile.

orgs.briefDescEn: A mental health service provider supporting individuals, couples, spouses, surviving family members, and children.
orgs.detailedDescEn: Wounded Warriors Canada (WWC) is a national mental health service provider dedicated to serving Trauma Exposed Organizations, Trauma Exposed Professionals, and their families. WWC specializes in providing culturally informed services that utilize a combination of education, counselling, and training approaches to support resiliency and recovery from post-trauma injuries.

domains.descEn: A sense of purpose in life is important to well-being. Transitioning members can feel lost or disoriented because they now need to replace the purpose they had in the military with something new.
domains.descFr: Le sentiment d’avoir un but précis dans la vie est important pour le bien-être. Les militaires en cours de transition vers la vie civile peuvent se sentir perdus ou désorientés, car ils doivent maintenant remplacer le but qu’ils avaient dans les Forces par quelque chose de nouveau.

orgs.briefDescEn: Writers Collective of Canada (WCC) is a charitable arts-health organization that ignites connection through creativity.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
When we write with others, we discover ourselves. Writers Collective of Canada (WCC) is a charitable arts-health organization that ignites connection through creativity by inspiring powerful, authentic stories shared in community.

Through partners, we offer our community writing workshop program that is proven to create deep connection, increase resilience, and strengthen self-advocacy among community members. Together, we empower and amplify the magnificent authentic voices of one and all.

orgs.briefDescEn: The YMCA of Owen Sound Grey Bruce is a charitable organization that has been igniting potential since 1877.
orgs.detailedDescEn: The YMCA of Owen Sound Grey Bruce is a charity dedicated to building a caring, healthy community by creating opportunities for all people to achieve personal growth in spirit, mind and body. Our core values guide our every day decisions and actions. Find opportunities for growth and connection through: Health, Fitness & Aquatics, Child Care, Employment Services, Community Initiatives, Immigrant Services, and Camps.

orgs.briefDescEn: Yorkville Education LP includes Yorkville University and Toronto Film School, with a mission to deliver flexible, career-focused education.
orgs.detailedDescEn:
Yorkville University began with a bold vision: to offer flexible, rigorous, career-focused programs that transform lives. Since 2004, Yorkville has expanded across Canada, offering both online and on-campus programs. Graduates have advanced their careers through programs in the behavioral sciences, social sciences, business, and creative arts.
Toronto Film School is an internationally recognized career college that prepares students for jobs in film, TV, video games, and graphic design.
